title: Multi-Site Customers: Added Installments on a New Agreement Security Deposit
content:
An established multi-site customer gets a longer installment plan for a Security Deposit on a new agreement.

**Rule.** Where three or more regular bills were issued on the customer's Electric Service Agreements in the 1 month ending on the payment date, 2 installments are added; where exactly two were, 1 is added; otherwise none is added.

| Regular bills issued on the customer's agreements in the 1 month ending on the payment date | Installments added |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 2 |
| Exactly two | 1 |
| One or none | None |

Only regular bills count; a final bill issued at the closing of an agreement is not a regular bill.

## Cases (hypothetical business customer, payment date 20 May)

- Regular bills issued on three site agreements on 25 April, 2 May and 9 May: three bills in the month, 2 added.
- Regular bills issued on two site agreements in the month, plus a final bill on a third: two regular bills, 1 added.
- One regular bill in the month: none added.
